title: Tanvi Sharma Youngest Ever BWF World Tour Champion
indian_angle: Indian teenager Tanvi Sharma secured her first BWF World Tour title, making history as the youngest winner.
summary: Indian prodigy Tanvi Sharma, 17, claimed her maiden BWF World Tour title in Chinese Taipei, winning the final in straight games and becoming the youngest champion in the tournament's history after three previous final losses.

title: BAI Announces Player Eligibility for World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has released the eligibility criteria for Indian players aspiring to compete in the BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: BAI has issued guidelines for player eligibility for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt, outlining the selection process for India's promising young badminton talent.

title: Bhubaneswar U-19 Tournament Designated World Junior Championships Selector
indian_angle: The Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament has been designated as the sole selection event for India's contingent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament has been postponed, and the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament will now serve as the official selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The new 3x15 scoring system will be adopted in all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: BAI Issues Advisory Against Unauthorized Badminton Leagues
indian_angle: Indian players and coaches are advised by BAI to avoid participating in unauthorized badminton leagues and tournaments to ensure compliance with official regulations.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued an advisory cautioning players and stakeholders against participating in unauthorized badminton leagues, tournaments, and championships, emphasizing adherence to official guidelines.

title: India Submits EOI to Host BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has submitted an Expression of Interest to host the prestigious BWF World Championships in 2026, potentially bringing the global event to India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has formally submitted an Expression of Interest to the BWF for hosting the World Championships in 2026, indicating India's ambition to stage a major international badminton event.
